count_inputs.augmentation_windows_assumption: each of the same 630 positive TRAIN and 1000 negative TRAIN rows is one retained window, as actually observed here

distribution_shift.control_caveat: Micro-only control has the TRAIN-discovered 39 BIO classes versus candidate 45; rate borrowed from candidate pilot is a proxy, not a measured control rate.
distribution_shift.length_caveat: Pilot padded batch token lengths were not instrumented. Whole-row mean is not retained-window mean or batch maximum. collate rounds batch maximum to 64-token buckets up to 512. A much smaller short-augmentation fraction changes random-batch maxima; attention cost depends on padded length, so steps/s need not transfer. Longer windows, MPS allocation/cache, sustained thermal/power state and fresh model startup also matter.

full_data_definition: all 30404 current provisional language-filtered Micro TRAIN manifest rows, NOT all publisher corpus rows or held-out rows

matched_study_definition.candidate: fresh pinned BASE, same Micro TRAIN plus 630 positive TRAIN and 1000 negative TRAIN, corrected protocol, one epoch; separate candidate positive-dev result
matched_study_definition.control: fresh pinned BASE, current Micro TRAIN only, corrected protocol, one epoch; current TRAIN-only discovery; Micro dev only
matched_study_definition.matching_required_before_future_executio: same seed/settings/pinned tokenizer/model revision, immutable input manifests, identical retained Micro dev ID population, identical scorer/preprocessing; record set hashes in future approved study
matched_study_definition.new_label_limit: Control has no USERNAME/ACCOUNTNUM/PERSONALREF train labels. Unchanged trainer cannot admit positive-dev labels for that control. Compare only the identical Micro dev population; candidate positive-dev remains separate and NOT a control-vs-candidate result. No label-map override or new framework is proposed.

overhead_proxy_caveat: Trainer eval_time_s starts before train-window construction/base loading and ends after checkpoint save plus both dev calls; it is not isolated evaluation time. Linear retained-dev-row scaling also scales those non-eval costs and ignores token lengths. Separate startup/filesystem residual is likewise not an isolated profiler measurement. No confidence bound, reservation guarantee or statistical interval.
status: PROVISIONAL; computation only; no full run authorized or started
